code.description:
Error code type, should be machine-friendly and human-readable.
 e.g: `"permission_denied"`, `"not_found"`

msg.description:
Explain the reason, could be displayed to user.
 e.g: `"You don't have permission to access this resource"`

data.description: Likes of songs that can be played.

unavailable.description:
Likes on this page of songs that were deleted or hidden, to show as unavailable.
 @since 261008

PublicUserProfile.description:
Shared user profile model — returned by all APIs that include user info.
 `is_following` / `is_followed_by` are `None` unless enriched via `get_user_profile`.

is_followed_by.description: @since 260619 — None when viewing own profile or unauthenticated, or when caller uses `get_common_user_profile`

is_following.description: @since 260619 — None when viewing own profile or unauthenticated, or when caller uses `get_common_user_profile`

explicit.description: @since 251105, should be required in new client.

jmid.description: @since 251114, should be required in new client.

audio_url.description:
Deprecated since 260114.
 Use detail endpoint to get audio URL
